name: Circle of the Sea

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A druid of storms and tides who wraps themselves in churning spray and lightning.

feature.name: Circle of the Sea Spells
feature.summary: Fog Cloud, Gust of Wind, Ray of Frost, Shatter and Thunderwave always prepared; more at levels 5, 7 and 9.
feature.text: When you reach a Druid level shown, you always have these spells prepared; they don't count against your Prepared Spells: Fog Cloud, Gust of Wind, Ray of Frost, Shatter and Thunderwave (3); Lightning Bolt and Water Breathing (5); Control Water and Ice Storm (7); Conjure Elemental and Hold Monster (9).

feature.name: Wrath of the Sea
feature.summary: Bonus Action, spend Wild Shape: a 5-foot emanation for 10 minutes; each turn one creature in it makes a Con save or takes Cold damage and is pushed.
feature.text: As a Bonus Action you can expend a use of Wild Shape to wreathe yourself in an emanation of ocean spray reaching 5 feet from you for 10 minutes (it ends early if you dismiss it, use it again or become Incapacitated). When it appears, and as a Bonus Action on later turns, choose one creature in it: it makes a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure it takes Cold damage equal to a number of d6s equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum one) and, if Large or smaller, is pushed up to 15 feet away from you. On a success it takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.

feature.name: Aquatic Affinity
feature.summary: Wrath of the Sea reaches 10 feet, and you gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.
feature.text: The emanation of your Wrath of the Sea grows to 10 feet, and you gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

feature.name: Stormborn
feature.summary: While Wrath of the Sea is active, fly at your Speed and resist Cold, Lightning and Thunder damage.

feature.name: Oceanic Gift
feature.summary: Wrath of the Sea can wrap a willing ally instead, or both of you for two Wild Shape uses.
